craft_notes: Sthāyin: marvel at untiring oneness. Device: end-dash→comma (teeming stated softly, triumph released). Rejected: 'wins' for 'triumphs' — kept triumphs. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Ever unflagging, peopling the triple sphere with hundred fancies,
yet single, seamless, triumphs the Birthless.
l4.sanskrit_cite: muhur muhur aviśrāntas trailokyaṃ kalpanāśataiḥ kalpayann api ko 'py eko nirvikalpo jayaty ajaḥ
